summary.text: Melissa Barnes is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 93, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A Social Security disability attorney, she previously taught math and science in York City schools.

paragraphs.text: Melissa Barnes graduated from York College of Pennsylvania in 2004, earned a master's degree from Johns Hopkins University in 2009, and received a law degree from Widener University Commonwealth Law School in 2022.
Her survey response says she taught math and science in York City schools for more than a decade and founded the York City Schools STEAM Academy.
It says that in 2025 she helped rekindle Indivisible York.
